I built this puzzle specifically for reverse, shortest was a last minute change.
I expect that this will be too difficult for most people to finish in 15 minutes. If programmers like @5DN1L and @User123 can't solve this within 5-10 minutes then I can make any of the following changes:
    -put month and year on the same line
    -remove border
    -remove month and year from output
